originalTitle: 墨染の桜 ～ Border of Life

lyrics.jp:
広がる世界に降り積もる 夢と共に風に舞う

一つ一つが忘れられない言の葉に それは綺麗で
それぞれ違う形で輝き出す それはかけがえの無い思い出

いつもそばに居るのに 見えていない
大切なものだから 隠したままで
壊れないで欲しいと思うことが
いつかそのことさえも忘れてしまう

広がる世界に降り積もる 永遠さえ雪の様
幾億の声が生まれでて 夢と共に風に舞う

折り重なりいずれ重みに潰されても 忘れられない
遠い記憶の果に住む儚さが見せた モノクロームの花びら

いつもそばに居るのに 見えていない
大切なものだから 隠したままで
壊れないで欲しいと思うことが
いつかそのことさえも忘れてしまう

lyrics.en:
Drifting through the vast, endless world
Dancing in the wind, together with our dreams

Each and every word left behind is unforgettable
So beautiful in its own way
Shining in different forms
Each one an irreplaceable memory

Though you’re always by my side, I cannot see you
Because it’s precious, I keep it hidden away
Wishing for it to never break
Until one day, even that wish is forgotten

Falling upon this vast world
Even eternity itself is like snow
Countless voices are born and carried away
Dancing with the wind, together with our dreams

Even if they pile up and collapse under their own weight
I can never forget
At the distant end of memory
Delicate monochrome petals bloom

Though you’re always by my side, I cannot see you
Because it’s precious, I keep it hidden away
Wishing for it to never break
Until one day, even that wish is forgotten

Falling upon this vast world
Even eternity itself is like snow
Countless voices are born and carried away
Dancing with the wind, together with our dreams

Though you’re always by my side, I cannot see you
Because it’s precious, I keep it hidden away
Wishing for it to never break
Until one day, even that wish is forgotten

Falling upon this vast world
Even eternity itself is like snow
Countless voices are born and carried away
Dancing with the wind, together with our dreams

Giữa thế gian rộng lớn, lặng lẽ lan rộng
Cùng những giấc mơ, nhảy múa theo làn gió

Từng lời nói không thể nào quên
Chúng thật đẹp đẽ biết bao
Mỗi kỷ niệm tỏa sáng theo cách riêng của mình
Không gì có thể thay thế được

Dù luôn ở bên cạnh, nhưng chẳng thể nhìn thấy
Bởi vì quá trân quý, nên cứ mãi giấu đi
Càng mong rằng nó đừng vỡ tan
Thì đến một ngày, ngay cả điều đó cũng sẽ bị lãng quên

Giữa thế gian rộng lớn, lặng lẽ lan rộng
